about: Per-word spelling rules for ACE-Step 1.5 Hindi bhajans (music/bhajan-batch.mjs singLyrics) and the deity-name QA (nameCheck). Source: pronunciation A/B pron-ab-001 (13 Nov 2026, music/lyrics/pron-ab-001.qa.json): श्‍याम with a zero-width joiner (U+200D between the virama and य) gave the 'Shy' glide in 3/3 takes (owner liked zwj-hi seed 2222: '1 no h'); plain Devanagari kept भोले aspirated in 2/3 takes while the ZWJ take lost it, so every other word stays plain. Lyrics are WRITTEN plain; `sing` is only what ACE-Step reads.

श्याम.note: Shaam/Sham (no y) = wrong; Whisper writes श्री श्याम as शाम by itself, so श्री-positions are never checked

forbidden.why: no Rani Sati bhajans (Sati Prevention Act rule)
Devanagari only (ACE-Step reads Roman Hindi worse)
no digits: write numbers as words

forbidden_khatu.why: Khatu Shyam ji = the sheesh only: no flute (channel iconography rule)

शिव शंकर को जिसने पूजा उसका ही उद्धार हुआ

मेरे बांके बिहारी लाल तू इतना ना करियो श्रृंगार
तेरी मंद मंद मुस्कनिया पे बलिहार

आओ सांवरिया हम तुम्हारे दर पे आए
मेरी झोपड़ी के भाग आज खुल जाएंगे
भोले बाबा पार करेगा

दुनिया चले ना श्री राम के बिना
